goal: Create one fail-closed repository publish authority binding source identity, explicit staging, test evidence, commit, normal push, remote verification, PR metadata, and fast CI.
acceptance_criteria: SourceIdentity remains read-only and fails closed on every required Git command.
ChangeManifest is the only staging input and unknown, secret, runtime, generated, cache, log, and temporary files cannot be committed by default.
TestReceipt binds the current source identity and every changed commit path.
The publish gate stages exact paths, verifies the staged tree, commits, runs post-commit critical checks, detects remote races, pushes without force, and verifies remote SHA equality.
release_candidate_gate retains release-readiness evaluation but no dirty classifier, concrete commit allowlist, or publish authority.
Fast CI is bounded, Provider-free, and does not grant product acceptance or delivery authority.

quality_metrics.measure: implicit staging commands in canonical path
stale or partially covered test receipts accepted
successful receipts without local/remote SHA equality

prevention: Inventory existing Git helpers and remove duplicate classifiers before adding the gate
Prohibit implicit staging and force options in code and contract
assurance: Use temporary repositories and bare remotes for adversarial tests
control: Run publish, source identity, release, hygiene, version, kernel, and mainline smoke tests
Dogfood the canonical publish path for the final commit and push
improvement: Retain a bounded publish receipt and separate scoped from repository-global verdicts

interface_expectations: CanonicalRepoPublishGate is the only staging, commit, push, and remote verification authority
GitHub CI supplies repository contract evidence only
acceptance, packaging, and delivery authorities remain unchanged

feedback: Repository publish scope passes; unrelated global quick failures remain.

worked: Temporary bare-remote tests exposed local/remote truth boundaries
One manifest classifier removed the concrete release-candidate allowlist
did_not_work: The repository-global quick baseline remains unhealthy outside this increment
experiments: Dogfood the final change through the new canonical publish command
